research_question: Which scientifically coherent experiment families can use the largest defensible share of the already-owned 2010+ Databento Henry Hub futures history without changing source semantics after seeing outcomes?
search_scope: Pre-audit source and literature review: Databento primary schema/dataset documentation, peer-reviewed natural-gas futures term-structure research, and EIA structural-regime evidence. No protected #271/#273 confirmation outcomes inspected.

sources.title: CME Globex MDP 3.0 data feed specifications
Natural-gas futures: Bias, predictive performance, and the theory of storage
Convenience yield in commodity price modeling: A regime switching approach
Average annual natural gas spot price in 2015 was at lowest level since 1999

claim_map.claim: Databento ohlcv-1d is a UTC-date electronic-trade aggregate; it is not official venue settlement and may differ from official volume/settlement.
The statistics schema carries official venue summary statistics including preliminary/final settlement, cleared volume and open interest, with stat_type and flags defining semantics.
Definition records provide point-in-time symbol and expiration information suitable for avoiding survivorship/lookahead in contract identity.

CME history before 2017-05-21 comes from legacy MDP2/FIX history and lacks independent capture timestamps, so source era must be explicitly represented and checked in robustness analysis rather than silently treated as identical.
Natural-gas futures basis/term structure is economically connected to storage/convenience yield and may occupy different contango/backwardation regimes.
The 2010-2015 U.S. natural-gas market underwent material production, price and storage changes, so calendar era cannot be assumed exchangeable without robustness checks.

expected_observations: If a data-first redesign is viable, definitions plus ohlcv-1d should support deterministic outright identity and at least two nearby outright trade bars across most of 2010+ without using settlement labels.

Official final-settlement semantics should remain materially less homogeneous in the early years than trade-bar OHLCV semantics, preserving #275's STOP for the frozen exact settlement-plus-volume extension.
A serious long-history candidate should have low single-year concentration and an effective-information envelope materially larger than the frozen #271/#273 design.
The 2017-05-21 feed transition and 2010-2015 economic transition should require predeclared robustness strata rather than outcome-driven exclusions.
disconfirming_observations: Long-history OHLCV has material unmapped contract identity, null/duplicate core bars, or coverage concentrated in a small number of years.
A proposed candidate becomes coherent only by relabeling OHLCV close as official settlement or mixing price semantics across eras.
Dependence-adjusted effective information remains too small for a material planning effect even after using the full owned history.
A candidate requires post-outcome roll, calendar-era or source-era selection rather than frozen admissibility rules.
